f.title: Request lifting of safety measures once safety and efficacy requirements are met
f.statement: Where the Secretariat has evidence that a health supply lacks safety, efficacy, purity or stability, it applies the safety measures of the General Health Law and may revoke the registration, notifying the holder so it can state its case. A holder that satisfies the safety and efficacy requirements set by the Secretariat may request lifting of the safety measures, provided the registration has not been revoked.
f.clause: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Sección Quinta, Artículo 37
f.exceptions: Only while the registration has not been revoked

rows.quote:
ARTÍCULO 37. Cuando la Secretaría cuente con evidencia de que un
Insumo carece de seguridad, eficacia, pureza o estabilidad, aplicará las
medidas de seguridad previstas en la Ley y, en su caso, revocará su
registro, lo que notificará al titular del registro para que exponga lo que
a su derecho convenga. Cuando este último satisfaga los requisitos de
seguridad y de eficacia que determine la Secretaría, podrá solicitar la
suspensión de las medidas de seguridad, siempre y cuando no se haya
revocado el registro.
rows.location: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Sección Quinta, Artículo 37
rows.review_note: Review: no change; holder's request is permissive ('podrá solicitar'); Secretariat actions kept as context only. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'podrá solicitar' = Permitted, holder explicit. Below 90: most of the quote and statement describe Secretariat actions; the holder's right is conditional.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 37. When the Secretariat has evidence that a Health Supply lacks safety, efficacy, purity or stability, it will apply the safety measures provided for in the Law and, where applicable, will revoke its registration, which it will notify to the registration holder so that it may state what is in its interest. When the latter satisfies the safety and efficacy requirements determined by the Secretariat, it may request the lifting of the safety measures, provided the registration has not been revoked.

f.title: Notify the Secretariat immediately of adverse reactions to health supplies
f.statement: Adverse reactions to medicines or other health supplies occurring during their marketing or use, those notified by health professionals, those published in the scientific literature and those reported by international health organisations shall be made known immediately to the Secretariat of Health by the registration holder, or by the distributors or marketers of the health supplies.
f.clause: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Sección Quinta, Artículo 38
f.applicability: Medicines and other health supplies during marketing or use; sources include health professionals, scientific literature and international health organisations
f.processes: Submission operations; Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder; distributors or marketers

Insumos que se presenten durante la comercialización o uso de éstos,
las notificadas por los profesionales de la salud, las publicadas en la
literatura científica y las reportadas por los organismos sanitarios
internacionales, deberán hacerse del conocimiento inmediato de la
Secretaría por el titular del registro, por los distribuidores o
comercializadores de los Insumos.
rows.location: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Sección Quinta, Artículo 38
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'deberán hacerse del conocimiento inmediato' = Mandatory, deadline 'immediately' (no day count in the RIS). Re-translation: agrees. Actors explicit (titular, distribuidores, comercializadores), 'deberán hacerse del conocimiento inmediato' = Mandatory, deadline 'immediately' explicit; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 38. Adverse reactions to medicines or other Health Supplies that occur during their marketing or use, those notified by health professionals, those published in the scientific literature and those reported by international health organisations shall be made known immediately to the Secretariat by the registration holder, or by the distributors or marketers of the Health Supplies.

f.title: Conduct biotech PV per the NOM with clear product identification
f.statement: Pharmacovigilance of biotechnological medicines shall be carried out in accordance with the corresponding Mexican official standard and shall allow clear identification of the biotechnological medicine, referring specifically to its manufacturer, International Nonproprietary Name, distinctive name and lot number.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

biotecnológicos deberá realizarse de conformidad con la norma
correspondiente. Dicha farmacovigilancia deberá permitir una clara
identificación   del  medicamento      biotecnológico,        refiriéndose
específicamente a su fabricante, a la Denominación Común
Internacional, a la denominación distintiva y al número de lote.

f.title: Guarantee quality control and pharmacovigilance as a condition of importing
f.statement: Registered health supplies may be imported for marketing by persons that have adequate facilities for their safe handling and that guarantee their quality control and pharmacovigilance in accordance with the requirements of the corresponding Mexican official standard.
f.clause: Título Quinto, Capítulo I, Artículo 131, segundo párrafo
f.applicability: Import of registered health supplies for marketing
f.exceptions: Permission conditional on guaranteeing quality control and pharmacovigilance per the corresponding NOM

rows.quote:
Podrán importar Insumos registrados para su comercialización, las
personas que cuenten con las instalaciones adecuadas para el manejo
seguro de los mismos y que garanticen el control de su calidad y
farmacovigilancia, de acuerdo con los requisitos establecidos en la
Norma correspondiente.
rows.location: Título Quinto, Capítulo I, Artículo 131, segundo párrafo
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'Podrán importar ... que garanticen' = permission conditioned on guaranteeing quality control and PV; level Permitted kept. Re-translation: agrees. rows.quote_en: Registered Health Supplies may be imported for marketing by persons who have adequate facilities for their safe handling and who guarantee their quality control and pharmacovigilance, in accordance with the requirements established in the corresponding Standard.

f.title: Replace the free-sale certificate for new molecular entities with Mexican clinical data and a risk document
f.statement: For foreign-manufactured allopathic medicines containing new molecular entities not marketed in any other country for lack of registration and intended to be registered in Mexico, the certificate of free sale may be replaced by the report of clinical studies with participation of the Mexican population demonstrating the product's safety, quality and efficacy, together with the document describing the activities and interventions designed to characterise and prevent the previously identified potential risks related to the medicines, including measurement of the effectiveness of those interventions.
f.clause: Título Sexto, Capítulo III, Artículo 170, fracción I, segundo párrafo
f.applicability: Foreign-manufactured allopathic medicines containing new molecular entities not marketed elsewhere

f.statement: The application for an innovator biotechnological medicine shall attach the preclinical and clinical studies the Secretariat indicates as necessary to demonstrate safety, efficacy and quality, including the report of adverse events and immunogenicity, characterising the immune response and evaluating the correlation between neutralising antibodies and the product's pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics.

disposiciones jurídicas aplicables, incluyendo el reporte de eventos
adversos e inmunogenicidad, caracterizando la respuesta inmune y la
evaluación de la correlación entre anticuerpos neutralizantes de la

f.title: Attach PV programme, immunogenicity studies and AE reports for biocomparables
f.statement: The application for marketing authorisation of a biocomparable biotechnological medicine shall attach the documentation in fractions I to IX of Article 177 and preclinical and clinical studies such as biocomparability studies, immunogenicity studies and adverse event reports, and others the Secretariat determines after the opinion of the New Molecules Committee.
f.clause: Título Sexto, Capítulo III, Artículo 177 Bis 2
f.processes: Submission operations; Risk management & minimisation; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.actor: Applicant for marketing authorisation of biocomparable biotechnological medicines

biotecnológicos biocomparables se requiere presentar solicitud en el
formato oficial, que para tal efecto se publique en el Diario Oficial de la
Federación, a la que se anexará la documentación contenida en las
fracciones I a IX del artículo 177 y los estudios preclínicos y clínicos como
estudios de biocomparabilidad, estudios de inmunogenicidad y
reportes de eventos adversos, y otros que la Secretaría determine,
previa opinión del Comité de Moléculas Nuevas.
rows.location: Título Sexto, Capítulo III, Artículo 177 Bis 2
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Below 90: actor (applicant) inferred.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 177 Bis 2. To obtain the marketing authorisation of biocomparable biotechnological medicines, an application must be submitted in the official format published for that purpose in the Diario Oficial de la Federación, to which will be attached the documentation contained in fractions I to IX of Article 177 and the preclinical and clinical studies such as biocomparability studies, immunogenicity studies and adverse event reports, and others that the Secretariat determines, after the opinion of the New Molecules Committee.

f.title: Test antibodies in clinical safety trials of biocomparables where immunity may affect function
f.statement: In the comparative clinical efficacy and safety studies of biocomparable biotechnological medicines, for medicines where the immune response could affect the endogenous protein or its biological function, antibody tests must be carried out in the clinical safety trials, taking into account hypersensitivity, infusion reactions, autoimmunity and loss of efficacy.

anticuerpos deben realizarse en los ensayos clínicos de seguridad,
tomando en cuenta el papel que pudieran tener la hipersensibilidad,
reacciones de infusión, la autogenicidad y pérdida de la eficacia.
rows.location: Título Sexto, Capítulo III, Artículo 177-bis 4, fracción V, inciso c

f.statement: To obtain the first renewal of a medicine's marketing authorisation, the application shall include the pharmacovigilance report of the medicine under the applicable rules.

f.title: Submit a technovigilance report per product with the first device registration renewal
f.statement: To obtain the first renewal of the registration of nationally manufactured medical devices (medical equipment, prostheses, orthoses, functional aids, diagnostic agents, dental supplies, surgical and wound-care material, hygiene products and other medical devices), the application shall include a technovigilance report per product under the applicable rules.

f.title: Notify the Secretariat immediately of any sanitary irregularity and its potential health risk
f.statement: Owners or responsible persons of establishments engaged in the processing of health supplies shall immediately notify the Secretariat of any sanitary irregularity they detect in the establishment and of the potential health risk it represents, and shall collaborate in the necessary safety measures.
f.applicability: Establishments engaged in the process of health supplies (manufacture, storage, distribution etc.)
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Cross-functional handoffs; Submission operations

rows.actor: Owners or responsible persons of establishments processing health supplies
rows.quote:

destinados al proceso de Insumos, deberán dar aviso inmediato a la
Secretaría de cualquier irregularidad sanitaria que detecten en el
mismo, del riesgo potencial para la salud que signifique y colaborar en
las medidas de seguridad necesarias.
rows.review_note: Review: added by reviewer (immediate notification of sanitary irregularities and their potential health risk, plus cooperation in safety measures; 'deberán dar aviso inmediato' = Mandatory). Actors explicit, 'deberán dar aviso inmediato' = Mandatory, statement adds nothing. Capped at 89: reviewer-added row whose quote_en was written by the reviewer without an independent re-translation.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 119.
